name: Spikes Studio
description_en:
Spikes Studio describes an AI video-clipping workflow that selects moments from source footage, adds captions, reframes and prepares clips for social channels. Its site also advertises scheduling, analytics and project organization; these depend on connected accounts and plan conditions.

The current homepage additionally promotes a micro-drama engine and library. This profile covers the documented clipping editor, not an assumed license to that library or a guarantee that every product surface has the same entitlements.
description_zh:
Spikes Studio 描述从原素材选择片段、添加字幕、重构图并准备社交短片的AI流程，也宣传排期、分析及项目整理，依赖连接账户和套餐条件。

当前首页还推广微短剧引擎及内容库。本文覆盖有文档描述的剪辑编辑器，不推定内容库许可，也不保证全部产品入口权益相同。

sections.title_en: Inspect clips against the complete recording
sections.en:
The homepage describes uploading video, finding moments and applying captions, transitions, branding and output formats. Its FAQ separately describes an Add Captions editor for videos up to five minutes. That limit should not be generalized to every long-video processing workflow without the relevant upload specification.

For a pilot, use an owned interview with an important qualification after the main claim. Check that the selected clip preserves that meaning, then inspect speaker crop, captions, names and numbers before export. An engagement or virality score is not proof of future views. No clip detection, transcription or render was tested here.
sections.zh:
首页说明上传视频、选片段并添加字幕、转场、品牌及输出格式。FAQ另述Add Captions编辑器支持最长五分钟视频，该限制不能在未查相应上传规格时泛化至全部长视频处理流程。

试点可用自有访谈，在主要主张后包含重要限定；核对所选短片保留语义，再在导出前检查说话者裁切、字幕、名称及数字。互动或传播评分不能证明未来播放量。本文未测试选片、转录或渲染。

sections.title_en: Minute allowances and storage windows differ
sections.title_zh: 分钟额度与存储期限不同
sections.en:
The pricing cards show PRO+ at displayed14.09 dollars/month billed annually with3600 minutes/year, or32.99 billed monthly with300 minutes/month. Enterprise shows56.34 annually with14400 minutes/year, or115.99 monthly with1200 minutes/month. The page’s per-minute labels do not consistently match those totals, so no normalized cost per minute is asserted. Dollar currency and final invoice were not independently confirmed.

The comparison gives seven-day Basic storage, ninety-day PRO+ storage and unlimited Enterprise storage, while paid exports are described as1080p without a watermark. Confirm retention of both sources and finished exports; download important files before the applicable window ends. A storage promise is not a verified backup or recovery guarantee.
sections.zh:
价格卡显示PRO+按年付月均14.09（$）、每年3600分钟，或月付32.99、每月300；Enterprise按年付月均56.34、每年14400分钟，或月付115.99、每月1200。页面每分钟标签与总额并非始终相符，本文不归一化分钟成本，也未独立确认$币种及最终账单。

比较表列Basic保留七天、PRO+九十天、Enterprise无限，并描述付费导出为无水印1080p。需确认原片及成片保留，期限前下载重要文件。存储承诺不是已验证备份或恢复保证。

sections.title_en: The free offer is internally inconsistent
sections.title_zh: 免费方案说明内部不一致
sections.en:
Basic cards say0.00/month with demo clips and watermarked720p exports, but the lower comparison labels Basic12.99. The pricing FAQ mentions up to thirty free minutes monthly, while the homepage describes demos and earned minutes. These conflict, so neither a payable Basic rate nor a guaranteed recurring free allowance is treated as confirmed.

The site describes connecting social accounts to publish and schedule. Verify the actual destination, account permissions and a draft post before enabling a schedule. Privacy claims, commercial footage rights, API access, failure charging, deleted-project recovery and micro-drama library rights were not verified. The platform source license is also unknown.
sections.zh:
Basic方案卡写月0.00、演示片段及带水印720p导出，但下方比较又将Basic标12.99。价格FAQ称每月最多三十免费分钟，首页则描述演示及获取分钟，互有冲突，因此Basic实收价及保证每月免费额度都不视为已确认。

官网描述连接社交账户发布及排期。启用排期前应核对真实目标、账户权限及草稿发布。未核隐私主张、商业素材权益、API访问、失败扣费、已删项目恢复及微短剧内容库权益，平台源码许可也未知。
